about: A toolkit programmers use to build bots that crawl websites and collect data from them.

prs.title: Sitemap pages wrapped in extra spacing are no longer lost
prs.broken: A sitemap is a file listing a site's pages for crawlers. When a page address had spaces or line breaks around it in a quoted block, the tool kept the space instead, dropped the page, and could crawl nothing.
prs.changed: The tool now ignores bits of text that are only spaces or line breaks.
prs.matters: Crawls that start from these sitemaps visit every page they list.
